response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something is missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize our kingdom's style. Something sleek, something futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
But, Your Majesty, we are in the Middle Ages. We can't just... (he gestures to the surrounding landscape)...do that.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense, Piper! I have a vision. (he turns to a nearby scribe, Scribe THOMAS) Thomas, get me a sketch artist.

SCRIBE THOMAS
Yes, Your Majesty.

The scribe scurries off, leaving the king to ponder his vision.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The scribe returns with a sketch artist, ARTIST LUCAS. The artist begins to sketch the king's vision: a kingdom transformed into a proto-vaporwave utopia.

ARTIST LUCAS
( gesturing to the sketch)
Your Majesty, I present to you... "Reginald's Realm 2.0".

KING REGINALD
(impressed)
By the saints, Lucas! This is it! This is the aesthetic I've been searching for.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The stone walls are now adorned with neon lights, and the thatched roofs are replaced with sleek, futuristic domes. The knights are now dressed in neon-colored armor, and the merchants are selling futuristic gadgets and gizmos.

KING REGINALD
(to his court)
By the power vested in me, I hereby declare this new aesthetic the official style of our kingdom!

The court erupts in cheers and applause as the king, surrounded by his loyal subjects, proudly surveys his new domain.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors, including Scribe Thomas and Jester Piper.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
We must make this new aesthetic a reality. I want neon lights, holographic projections, and... (he looks around the room)...more jellyfish.

SCRIBE THOMAS
Uh, Your Majesty, I'm not sure that's possible.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense, Thomas! I have a team of engineers working on it as we speak. (he turns to Jester Piper) Piper, get the engineers on it, pronto!

JESTER PIPER
Yes, Your Majesty!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a fully-fledged proto-vaporwave utopia. The king, surrounded by his subjects, proudly surveys his new domain.

KING REGINALD
(to his subjects)
We are the pioneers of a new era! An era of sleek, futuristic design and... (he looks around the room)...more jellyfish!

The subjects cheer and applaud as the king, surrounded by his loyal subjects, proudly declares:

KING REGINALD
(to his subjects)
We shall rule this kingdom with an iron fist... and a neon-lit fist!

The camera zooms out as the kingdom descends into chaos, with subjects running about, trying to keep up with the king's new aesthetic.

FADE TO BLACK.
